config.name: r9-two-step
config.note: Round 9. Two System-1 steps: step 1 answers (commit) or abstains; step 2, for abstained pairs only, reads the terrain and picks the design (stay with System 1 on writing, reference first on reasoning then the System-2 verdict if still under the stop, System-2 verdict elsewhere). Thresholds fitted on the tuning half: the cheapest setting whose cross-fitted tuning accuracy is within 0.5 point of the best (commit 0.8, reference stop 0.6).

secondary_config.name: r6-ref-first
secondary_config.note: Round 6. Reference first on reasoning terrain: the reference check joins stage 1 there; the System-2 verdict is added only when the mix is still under the boundary.

note: Sealed signals (s1p, route, ref, s2v, length) were collected under the first freeze (r6, commit 60da2848) and never scored. The primary was changed to r9-two-step before any sealed score was computed or read; both configurations use the same experts and the same frozen weights.
rule_for_a_win: Per benchmark and baseline: paired bootstrap (20,000 draws, resampling prompt groups) of MoJ minus baseline. Holm over the 6 comparisons (3 benchmarks x promptfoo and our ledger). A win when the Holm-adjusted lower bound is above 0 at no more System-2 calls per pair than that baseline; a loss when the upper bound is below 0; else a tie. Overall better only if every cell is a win or a tie and at least one is a win. On writing a win also needs MoJ above longer wins; else the report says the benchmark does not measure judging there.
scoring: JudgeBench: a pair is right only when both games are right (strict); half credit reported beside it. MM-Eval and writing: tie or split counts half.
